warmup.description: Every selected request executes both arms adjacently in each untimed pass. The second pass reverses the first pass arm order.

measurement.description: Each selected request executes one adjacent timed P/B pair. No other benchmark scope runs in the process before measurement.
measurement.mps_synchronization: Immediately before and after every timed operation.

counterbalancing.description: Every request is P-first in exactly three processes and B-first in exactly three. Each process has 50 P-first decision requests, 50 P-first Korean requests, and 32 P-first controls. Request order is independently digest-ranked per process.

negative_control.failure_definition: The equal-workload point ratio is outside the material interval or the crossed process-and-parent 95% interval excludes one.

uncertainty.process_parent_method: Crossed resampling: sample six processes with replacement and source-namespaced parents with replacement, then retain all selected process-by-parent observations.

interpretation: A passing result describes warmed steady-state MPS batch-one complete-request latency on the frozen public-development workloads. It does not replace the original benchmark or measure cold start, transport, or transient peak memory.
